name: OpenShell
description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
one_liner: A locked-down, sandboxed 'safe room' for running autonomous AI agents, so they can't touch files, networks, or credentials they weren't explicitly allowed to.
buyer: A security or compliance lead at a mid-size company who wants to let AI agents run autonomously without giving them unrestricted access to company systems.
business_use_cases: A fintech company runs its AI coding agents inside it so they can edit code but never reach production credentials or customer data.
A managed-IT provider offers 'locked-down AI agent hosting' to clients nervous about letting AI touch their infrastructure.
A SaaS company lets customer-facing AI support agents run customer-specific scripts safely isolated from other tenants' data.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version with pre-built policy templates (finance, healthcare, dev) as a compliance-focused SaaS for companies that won't self-host sandboxing infrastructure.

steal_this: Build and sell a one-click 'AI agent sandbox' preset for a specific vertical, like a law firm or clinic, this weekend as a $99 compliance starter pack.
